title: Horizontal Tangents of a Cubic Curve
author: Muhammad Abdullah Athar
problemStatement: Find all points on the curve f(x) = 2x^3 - 3x^2 - 12x + 5 where the tangent line is horizontal.

steps.title: Compute Derivative Function f'(x)
steps.explanation: Apply power rule to differentiate each term.
steps.why: Derivative gives the slope of the tangent at any x.

steps.title: Set Derivative Equal to Zero for Horizontal Tangents
steps.explanation: Horizontal tangent means slope m = 0. Factor the quadratic.

steps.title: Solve for x and Find Corresponding y-values
steps.explanation: Substitute critical x-values back into original curve f(x).
steps.why: Points on the curve require coordinates (x, f(x)).
